description: Meta's Muse Spark as a coding agent inside VS Code: streaming chat, tool calls with diffs, permission modes, session history and voice dictation, on your Muse subscription (Muse Code CLI) or a Model API key. Unofficial.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Muse Spark Code needs a real file system: the Muse Code CLI and the built-in tools read and write workspace files directly.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode the agent does not load the workspace's rules (AGENTS.md), skills or memory, runs no shell commands, and the extension runs no git. Trust the workspace to enable them. The settings that choose what runs and what is billed are machine-scoped, so a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot set them; in a remote window, where a dev container definition can, Bypass permissions always asks first.

config.title: Muse Spark
config.preferredLocation.enumDescription: Open new conversations in the Muse Spark sidebar view.
Open new conversations as editor tabs.
config.initialPermissionMode.enumDescrip: Edit automatically: auto-approve file edits and common filesystem commands.
Plan: research only until the plan is approved.
Auto: the host reviews actions and prompts only when needed.
Bypass permissions: everything without asking (use only in sandboxes).
config.archiveInactiveSessions.descripti: Hide sessions idle for this many days from the History dialog (they stay on disk; Show archived lists them).
config.archiveInactiveSessions.enumDescr: Hide sessions idle for a day.
Hide sessions idle for two days.
Hide sessions idle for a week.
Hide sessions idle for two weeks.
config.cleanupPeriodDays.description: Delete Meta Model API conversations idle for more than this many days when a window lists them; 0 keeps them for ever. Muse Code CLI sessions are kept by the CLI.
config.backend.description: Which backend hosts conversations. The pasted Model API key is never handed to the Muse Code CLI, so subscription work is never billed to the key.
config.backend.enumDescriptions.auto: Muse Code when the CLI is installed and signed in (billed to your Muse subscription); otherwise the Meta Model API when a key is stored; otherwise Muse Code's sign-in.
config.backend.enumDescriptions.museCode: Always the Muse Code CLI, with its own sign-in.
config.backend.enumDescriptions.modelApi: Always the Meta Model API with the key you pasted (pay as you go), using the extension's own tools.
config.shellSandbox.description: Whether shell commands run inside Muse Code's OS sandbox. Changing it restarts the Muse Code host.
config.shellSandbox.enumDescriptions.aut: Use Muse Code's OS sandbox for shell commands, except on Windows for a workspace under your user profile, where the sandbox cannot run commands (they run directly as you there, still gated by approvals).
config.shellSandbox.enumDescriptions.mus: Always use Muse Code's OS sandbox for shell commands.
config.shellSandbox.enumDescriptions.off: Never sandbox shell commands: they run directly as you, gated by the approval cards, as in Claude Code. Muse Code then also lets file tools write outside the workspace.
config.autosave.description: Save every dirty editor before each turn.
config.attachOpenFile.description: Show the open-file chip and attach the active file (or its selection) to each message. Turn off to attach neither.
config.useCtrlEnterToSend.description: Send with Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) instead of Enter.
config.hideOnboarding.description: Hide the onboarding checklist in new conversations.
config.focusView.description: Focus view: hide tool calls and reasoning, show only prompts and responses.
config.respectGitIgnore.description: Exclude .gitignore patterns from file searches and @-mentions.
config.confidentialWorkspace.description: Treat this workspace as confidential: contributor-tier models (whose traffic Meta may use for training) are blocked.
config.allowDangerouslySkipPermissions.d: Allow dangerously skip permissions: list Bypass permissions in the Modes menu. Muse then edits files and runs commands without asking; use only in a sandbox.
config.museBinaryPath.description: Absolute path to the Muse Code executable. Leave empty to discover it on PATH or in the default install directory.
config.environmentVariables.description: Environment variables set for the Muse Code process. Do not put API keys here; use the Sign in flow, which stores them in secret storage.
config.enableNewConversationShortcut.des: Use Ctrl+N (Cmd+N on macOS) to start a new conversation while a Muse Spark panel is focused.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get started with Muse Spark
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: Meta's Muse Spark as a coding agent in VS Code: open the panel, sign in, chat about your code.
Muse Spark reads your files, edits them under the permission mode you choose, runs commands with your approval, and follows the workspace’s AGENTS.md rules and skills.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.step.open.des:
Click the Muse Spark icon in the activity bar, or press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Escape on Windows, Cmd+Shift+Escape on macOS or Ctrl+Shift+Escape on Linux for a conversation in an editor tab.
[Open Muse Spark](command:museSpark.openInSidebar)
walkthrough.gettingStarted.step.signIn.d: Sign in with your Meta account through the Muse Code CLI (billed to your Muse subscription), or paste a Model API key from dev.meta.ai (pay as you go).
walkthrough.gettingStarted.step.chat.tit: Chat, mention files, pick a mode
walkthrough.gettingStarted.step.chat.des:
Type a message and press Enter. / opens the palette, @ mentions a file, Shift+Tab cycles the permission mode, and the History dialog brings past conversations back.
[Create AGENTS.md](command:museSpark.createRulesFile)
config.modelApiWebSearch.description: Paid, off by default. On the Model API backend, lets the model search the web as it answers, at $2.50 per 1,000 searches billed to your Model API key on top of tokens. Turning it on asks you to confirm the price; each search shows in the conversation marked paid and is counted in Account & usage.
config.modelApiImageGeneration.descripti: Paid, off by default. On the Model API backend, lets the model create PNG image files in the workspace with muse-image-1.0, at $0.01 per image billed to your Model API key. You are asked before every image, in every permission mode. Turning it on asks you to confirm the price.
config.modelApiVoice.description: Paid, off by default. On the Model API backend, the microphone sends what you record to Meta's Muse Voice Transcribe instead of your computer's own recogniser, at $0.18 per hour of audio billed to your Model API key. Turning it on asks you to confirm the price; the microphone says when it is the paid one.
